name: SuggestedPostRefunded
description: Describes a service message about a payment refund for a suggested post.

fields.name: suggested_post_message
fields.description: Message containing the suggested post. Note that the [Message](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#message) object in this field will not contain the _reply\_to\_message_ field even if it itself is a reply.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Reason for the refund. Currently, one of “post\_deleted” if the post was deleted within 24 hours of being posted or removed from scheduled messages without being posted, or “payment\_refunded” if the payer refunded their payment.
